name: append_spreadsheet_values
description: Appends values to a range in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to append values to.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to append values to. Supports various formats:

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.
Values are appended after the last row of data in the specified range.

valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted. Allowed: 'RAW', 'USER_ENTERED'.

values.description:
The values to append to the range (list of rows). Each inner list represents a row.
Each cell value can be:
- str: Text value for the cell
- int: Integer numeric value for the cell
- float: Decimal numeric value for the cell
- bool: Boolean value for the cell (True/False)
- None: Empty cell value

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

insertDataOption.description: How the input data should be inserted. Allowed: 'OVERWRITE', 'INSERT_ROWS'. Defaults to None (behaves like 'INSERT_ROWS' for appending).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the appended values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description: How values should be rendered in the response. Allowed: 'FORMATTED_VALUE', 'UNFORMATTED_VALUE', 'FORMULA'. Defaults to 'FORMATTED_VALUE'.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Allowed: 'SERIAL_NUMBER', 'FORMATTED_STRING'. Defaults to 'SERIAL_NUMBER'.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. Allowed: 'ROWS' (default), 'COLUMNS'. Defaults to "ROWS".

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"

name: batch_update_spreadsheet
description:
Applies one or more updates to the spreadsheet.

Description: This function applies one or more updates to the spreadsheet.
It supports the following request types:
- addSheetRequest - Adds a new sheet to the spreadsheet.
- deleteSheetRequest - Deletes an existing sheet from the spreadsheet.
- updateSheetPropertiesRequest - Updates the properties of an existing sheet.
- updateCells - Updates the cells in a specified range of the spreadsheet.
- updateSheetProperties - Updates the properties of an existing sheet.
The function validates the requests and updates the spreadsheet accordingly.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. If you do not have a spreadsheet ID, use create_spreadsheet to create a new spreadsheet first.

requests.description:
List of update requests. Defaults to None.
Each dictionary in the list must contain exactly one key, which specifies the type of
request. The value for that key is a dictionary payload for the request.
Supported request keys and their payload structures:
- 'addSheetRequest': Payload must conform to AddSheetRequestPayload.
     Requires 'properties'. sheetId is optional and auto-generated if omitted.
- 'deleteSheetRequest': Payload must conform to DeleteSheetRequestPayload.
    Requires 'sheetId'.
- 'updateSheetPropertiesRequest': Payload must conform to UpdateSheetPropertiesRequestPayload.
    Requires 'properties' (with 'sheetId') and 'fields'.
- 'updateCells': Payload must conform to UpdateCellsPayload.
    Requires 'range' and 'rows'.
- 'updateSheetProperties': Payload must conform to UpdateSheetPropertiesSimplePayload.
    Requires 'properties' (with 'sheetId'); 'fields' is optional.

.. hlist::
   :columns: 1

   * **addSheetRequest** (`Dict`) - Adds a new sheet.
   * **deleteSheetRequest** (`Dict`) - Deletes a sheet.
   * **updateSheetPropertiesRequest** (`Dict`) - Updates a sheet's properties.
   * **updateCells** (`Dict`) - Updates cells in a sheet.
   * **updateSheetProperties** (`Dict`) - Updates a sheet's properties (simplified).

.. rubric:: Requests

.. code-block:: json

   [
       {
           "addSheetRequest": {
               "properties": {
                   "sheetId": 1,
                   "title": "New Sheet"
               }
           }
       },
       {
           "deleteSheetRequest": {
               "sheetId": 0
           }
       }
   ]

.. container:: oneof

   .. container:: addSheetRequest

      Adds a new sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: properties

      .. rubric:: Properties

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "sheetId": 12345,
             "title": "New Sheet"
         }

   .. container:: deleteSheetRequest

      Deletes a sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: sheetId

      .. rubric:: sheetId

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "sheetId": 12345
         }

   .. container:: updateSheetPropertiesRequest

      Updates a sheet's properties.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: properties, fields

      .. rubric:: Properties and Fields

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "properties": {
                 "sheetId": 12345,
                 "title": "Updated Sheet"
             },
             "fields": "title"
         }

   .. container:: updateCells

      Updates cells in a sheet.

      .. show_properties::
         :properties: rows, range

      .. rubric:: Rows and Range

      .. code-block:: json

         {
             "rows": [
                 ["A1", "B1"],
                 ["A2", "B2"]
             ],
             "range": {
                 "sheetId": 0,
                 "startRowIndex": 0,
                 "endRowIndex": 2,
                 "startColumnIndex": 0,
                 "endColumnIndex": 2
             }
         }

name: batch_update_spreadsheet_values
description: Updates values in multiple ranges of a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Must be a non-empty string.

valueInputOption.description:
How the input data should be interpreted.
                  Valid values:
                  - "RAW": Values are inserted as-is, without any parsing.
                  - "USER_ENTERED": Values are parsed as if entered into Sheets by a user.
                    Formulas are stored as formulas, strings that look like dates or times
may be converted to date/time values, plain numbers are converted to numbers.

data.description: List of update requests, each containing a range and values to update.

items.description: An update request containing a range and values.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to update.
                                Supports various formats:
                                - Single cell: "A1"
                                - Cell range: "A1:B2"
                                - Full column: "A:B"
                                - Full row: "1:2"
                                - Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)
                                With sheet names:
                                - Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
                                - Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
                                - Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
                                - Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
                                - Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"
Note: If no sheet name is specified, uses first sheet in spreadsheet data.

values.description: The values to update in the range (list of rows). Each inner list represents a row. Cell values can be string, number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string (text), number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Optional. Whether to include the updated values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description:
Optional. How values should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE".
Valid values:
- "FORMATTED_VALUE": Values are calculated and formatted as they appear in the UI.
- "UNFORMATTED_VALUE": Values are calculated but not formatted in the reply.
- "FORMULA": Values are not calculated. The reply includes formulas.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description:
Optional. How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "SERIAL_NUMBER".
Valid values:
- "SERIAL_NUMBER": Date/time values are returned as Excel serial numbers.
- "FORMATTED_STRING": Date/time values are returned as formatted strings.

name: batch_update_spreadsheet_values_by_data_filter
description: Updates values in a spreadsheet using data filters.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

valueInputOption.description: Determines how input data should be interpreted. Valid values: "RAW" (values are stored as-is), "USER_ENTERED" (values are parsed as if entered by a user). "INPUT_VALUE_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED" is not allowed and must not be used.

data.description:
List of update requests. Each request is a dictionary that must contain:
- values (required): A 2D array where each inner array represents a row of cell values. Each cell value can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).
- Either dataFilter OR range (but not both) to specify the target range:
    * dataFilter: An object containing 'a1Range' (string) - The A1 notation of the range (e.g., "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3")
    * range: A string with the A1 notation of the range. Supports various formats:
      Basic ranges (uses default sheet): "A1", "A1:B2", "A:B", "A2:Z"
      With sheet names: "Sheet1!A1:B2", "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes for spaces), "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes), "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

values.description: Required. The values to update in the range. A 2D array where each inner array represents a row of cell values.

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

dataFilter.description: Optional (use either this or "range", not both). A data filter object specifying the target range using structured criteria. Defaults to None.

a1Range.description: The A1 notation of the range. The A1 notation is a syntax used to define a cell or range of cells with a string that contains the sheet name plus the starting and ending cell coordinates using column letters and row numbers like: "Sheet1!A1:D3" or "A1:D3"

range.description:
Optional (use either this or "dataFilter", not both). The A1 notation of the range. Defaults to None. Supports various formats:
Basic ranges (uses default sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names:
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the updated values in the response. Defaults to False.

responseValueRenderOption.description: Determines how values in the response should be rendered. Valid values: "FORMATTED_VALUE", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE", "FORMULA". Defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE".

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description: Determines how dates, times, and durations in the response should be rendered. This is ignored if responseValueRenderOption is "FORMATTED_VALUE". Valid values: "SERIAL_NUMBER", "FORMATTED_STRING". Defaults to "SERIAL_NUMBER".

    - Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
    - Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
    - Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
    - Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"
    - Sheet-only: "Sheet1" (entire sheet)

    Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension that results should use. If not specified, defaults to "ROWS". Valid values: "ROWS", "COLUMNS".

valueRenderOption.description: How values should be rendered in the output. If not specified, defaults to "FORMATTED_VALUE". Valid values: "FORMATTED_VALUE", "UNFORMATTED_VALUE", "FORMULA".

dateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates, times, and durations should be rendered. If not specified, defaults to "FORMATTED_STRING". Valid values: "SERIAL_NUMBER", "FORMATTED_STRING".

name: update_spreadsheet_values
description: Updates values in a specific range of a spreadsheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update.

range.description:
The A1 notation of the range to update. Supports various formats:

Basic ranges (without sheet name - uses first sheet):
- Single cell: "A1"
- Cell range: "A1:B2"
- Full column: "A:B"
- Full row: "1:2"
- Mixed range: "A2:Z" (from cell A2 to end of column Z)

With sheet names (recommended for multi-sheet spreadsheets):
- Simple sheet: "Sheet1!A1:B2"
- Default sheets: "Sheet2!A:A", "sheet1!1:10"
- Sheet with spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2" (use single quotes)
- Sheet with apostrophes: "'John''s Sheet'!A1" (escape apostrophes with double apostrophes)
- Sheet with special characters: "'Data-Sheet (2024)'!A1:D10"

Note: If no sheet name specified, first sheet is automatically used.

valueInputOption.description:
How the input data should be interpreted.
Valid values: "RAW" (values inserted as-is) or
"USER_ENTERED" (values parsed as if entered by user).
In USER_ENTERED mode, date-like strings are interpreted
according to the spreadsheet's locale (for example, "en_US"
uses MM/DD/YYYY, while "en_GB"/"en_AU" use DD/MM/YYYY) and may
be converted to underlying date serial numbers.

values.description: The values to update in the range (list of rows). Each inner list represents a row, and each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null (empty cell) value.

items.description: A row of cell values. Each cell can contain a string, number, boolean, or null value.
Cell value. Can be a string (text), number, boolean, or null (empty cell).

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the updated values in the response.

responseValueRenderOption.description:
How values should be rendered in the response.

Valid values:
- "FORMATTED_VALUE": Returns formatted values. In this mode
  responseDateTimeRenderOption is ignored and date values are returned as
  formatted strings.
- "UNFORMATTED_VALUE": Returns the underlying stored values; when combined
  with responseDateTimeRenderOption="SERIAL_NUMBER", date values are
  returned as locale-aware serial numbers.
- "FORMULA": Preserves formulas in the response; non-formula cells are
  rendered according to responseDateTimeRenderOption.

responseDateTimeRenderOption.description:
How dates, times, and durations should be rendered in the response. Defaults to "SERIAL_NUMBER".

Valid values:
- "SERIAL_NUMBER": Converts recognized date values to Excel-style serial numbers,
  using the spreadsheet's locale (for example, "en_US" as MM/DD/YYYY and
  "en_GB"/"en_AU" as DD/MM/YYYY). Date parsing for serial numbers respects the
  spreadsheet's locale in the same way as USER_ENTERED date input.
- "FORMATTED_STRING": Returns date values as plain strings with any internal
  DATE: markers stripped.

This option is applied only when responseValueRenderOption is "UNFORMATTED_VALUE"
or "FORMULA"; it is ignored when responseValueRenderOption is "FORMATTED_VALUE".
